formulas.total_costs_and_other_deductions: purchased_crude_oil_and_products + operating_expenses + selling_general_and_administrative_expenses + exploration_expenses + depreciation_depletion_and_amortization + taxes_other_than_income + interest_and_debt_expense + other_net_periodic_benefit_costs

sales_and_other_operating_revenues_yoy.description: Sales and other operating revenues YoY growth rate vs Q-4

purchased_crude_oil_and_products_margin_.description: Purchased crude oil and products as % of total revenues and other income, delta vs Q-4

operating_expenses_margin_delta_bps.description: Operating expenses as % of total revenues and other income, delta vs Q-4

selling_general_and_administrative_expen.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses as % of total revenues and other income, delta vs Q-4

exploration_expenses_yoy.description: Exploration expenses YoY growth rate vs Q-4

depreciation_depletion_and_amortization_.description: Depreciation, depletion and amortization as % of total revenues and other income, delta vs Q-4

income_from_equity_affiliates_yoy.description: income_from_equity_affiliates YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_income_net_abs.description: other_income_net absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

taxes_other_than_income_yoy.description: taxes_other_than_income YoY growth rate vs Q-4

interest_and_debt_expense_yoy.description: interest_and_debt_expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_net_periodic_benefit_costs_yoy.description: other_net_periodic_benefit_costs YoY growth rate vs Q-4

nci_abs.description: nci absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
